text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between users and servers. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or extra steps like two-factor verification. Input validation is equally important, because it checks the information users submit and blocks harmful code. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can seriously damage a site. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer applications and protect both user data and company reputation.
